description.value: Wally's Burgers is a family-operated, seasonal burger stand with over 65 years of history, currently serving at Cates Park in North Vancouver. Known for classic burgers, loaded hot dogs, crispy sides, shakes, and the legendary Wally's Sauce — a recipe perfected over 50 years — it has been a gathering place for generations of Lower Mainland locals. The park setting and nostalgic menu make it a natural pit stop for cyclists exploring the North Shore.
